title: 28m Custom Line Motor Yacht S-Cape Sold and Renamed
description: The 28.31-metre Custom Line motor yacht S-Cape sold in a deal with Florida Yachts International representing the buyer and Jean Lacombe of Yachts Invest standing in for the seller during negotiations. The Italian-built yacht was delivered in 2014 as part of the Custom Line Navetta 28 series and has been renamed D’Vinci by her new owners.
html:
Written by Sophie Spicknell
30 May 2022 | 04:30 ()

The 28.31-metre Custom Line motor yacht S-Cape sold in a deal with Florida Yachts International representing the buyer and Jean Lacombe of Yachts Invest standing in for the seller during negotiations. The Italian-built yacht was delivered in 2014 as part of the Custom Line Navetta 28 series and has been renamed D’Vinci by her new owners.

D’Vinci features exterior and interior design by Zuccon International Project while her naval architecture is the work of her builder, Custom Line Spa. She is recognisable by her unmistakable exterior profile and flexibility between indoor and outdoor spaces.

D’Vinci is able to accommodate up to 11 guests across five luxurious ensuite staterooms. The owner’s suite is located on the main deck with four guest staterooms on the lower deck including three VIP doubles and one twin with a pullman.

Performance-wise, D’Vinchi is equipped with twin MAN engines that power her to a top speed of 16 knots and a comfortable cruising speed of 13.5 knots. She will be shipped to the Mediterranean for summer navigation before being exported to Florida, USA for her new owners. D’Vinci had a last known asking price of €4,600,000.
